notes: PT-ARCH-007 / F9 / G5. Contract names coexist with E codes; see docs/ERROR_CONTRACT_NAMES.md.

contract_names.name: CapabilityUnavailable
contract_names.description: Requested capability, model, or path is unavailable under declared protocol facts
contract_names.notes: E1005 includes compliance aliases capability_not_declared / unsupported_capability

contract_names.name: PolicyRejected
contract_names.description: Host or provider policy denied the action (allowlist, spend, approval, account policy)
contract_names.notes: Host Policy Spec denials should prefer this name even when no provider round-trip occurred

contract_names.name: ProtocolViolation
contract_names.description: Request or response violates the protocol contract (shape, required fields, unsupported combination)

contract_names.name: ProviderFailure
contract_names.description: Well-formed request failed on the provider or transport side
